sentences.text: Education is the transmission of knowledge and skills and the development of character traits.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: the transmission of knowledge and skills and the development of character traits

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Education is ...，两个并列表语是 the transmission ... 与 the development ...。第一个 and 连接 knowledge 与 skills，第二个 and 才连接传授与培养这两个方面。

sentences.text: Formal education happens in a complex institutional framework, like public schools.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Formal education happens，happens 是不及物动词。in a complex institutional framework 说明发生的环境；like public schools 举例说明这种制度框架，并非把公立学校列为唯一形式。

sentences.text: Non-formal education is also structured but occurs outside the formal schooling system, while informal education is unstructured learning through daily experiences.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: while informal education is unstructured learning through daily experiences

sentences.readingHintZh: 前半句 Non-formal education is also structured but occurs ... 共用一个主语；structured 描述有组织的状态。while 表示对比，后半句另以 informal education 为主语，强调 unstructured learning through daily experiences。

existingAnnotation.text: Non-formal education is also structured but occurs outside the formal schooling system, while informal education is unstructured learning through daily experiences.
existingAnnotation.translation: 非正规教育也有一定结构，但发生在正规学校教育体系之外；而非正式教育则是通过日常经历进行的非结构化学习。
existingAnnotation.analysis: 句中while连接对比关系的两个分句。前一个分句以Non-formal education为主语，is与occurs构成并列谓语；后一个分句以informal education为主语，through daily experiences说明学习的途径。
existingAnnotation.label: 原有整句译文与讲解（AI 编写）

sourceSpan.text: Non-formal education is also structured but occurs outside the formal schooling system, while informal education is unstructured learning through daily experiences.

sentences.text: Formal and non-formal education are divided into levels that include early childhood education, primary education, secondary education, and tertiary education.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: that include early childhood education, primary education, secondary education, and tertiary education

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Formal and non-formal education are divided into levels，用被动结构说明层次划分。that 引导修饰 levels 的定语从句，include 后的四项是各教育阶段，and 连接最后一项。

sentences.text: Other classifications focus on the teaching method, like teacher-centered and student-centered education, and on the subject, like science education, language education, and physical education.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Other classifications focus on ...。两个 on 短语并列：on the teaching method 与 on the subject；每个后面的 like 短语分别举例，注意不要把教学方法与学科名混在同一分类维度。

sentences.text: The term "education" can also refer to the mental states and qualities of educated people and the academic field studying educational phenomena.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 The term education can also refer to ...。to 后有两层并列：mental states and qualities，以及 the academic field；studying educational phenomena 是现在分词短语，后置修饰 field。

sentences.text: The precise definition of education is disputed, and there are disagreements about what the aims of education are and to what extent education is different from indoctrination by fostering critical thinking.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: what the aims of education are
to what extent education is different from indoctrination by fostering critical thinking

sentences.readingHintZh: and 连接“定义有争议”与 there are disagreements 两个分句。about 后并列 what the aims ... are 和 to what extent education is different ... 两个间接疑问从句；后者询问差异程度，by fostering ... 表示培养批判性思维这一方式。

sentences.text: These disagreements affect how to identify, measure, and improve forms of education.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: how to identify, measure, and improve forms of education

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 These disagreements affect ...。how to identify, measure, and improve ... 是疑问词加不定式结构，作 affect 的宾语；三个动词并列，共用 to 和 forms of education 这一对象。

sentences.text: Fundamentally, education socializes children into society by teaching cultural values and norms.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 education socializes children into society，children 是宾语。by teaching ... 表示实现社会化的方式；values 与 norms 是 teaching 的并列宾语，Fundamentally 限定整句的论述角度。

sentences.text: It equips them with the skills needed to become productive members of society.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: to become productive members of society

sentences.readingHintZh: It 指教育，them 指上一句的儿童。equip somebody with something 表示赋予某人某种能力；needed to become ... 是修饰 skills 的过去分词结构，说明成为社会成员所需的技能。

sentences.text: This way, it stimulates economic growth and raises awareness of local and global problems.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: it 仍指教育，stimulates 与 raises 是两个并列谓语。economic growth 是前者的宾语，awareness ... 是后者的宾语；local 与 global 共同修饰 problems。

sentences.text: Organized institutions affect many aspects of education.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Organized institutions affect many aspects。Organized 是 institutions 的前置修饰语，不是本句谓语；of education 说明受影响的是教育的哪些方面。

sentences.text: For example, governments set education policies to determine when school classes happen, what is taught, and who can or must attend.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: to determine when school classes happen, what is taught, and who can or must attend

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 governments set education policies，to determine ... 表示目的。determine 后并列三个名词性从句：when ... happen、what is taught、who can or must attend；最后一个从句也在 determine 的范围内，can 与 must 表示不同的许可或义务。

sentences.text: International organizations, like UNESCO, have been influential in promoting primary education for all children.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 International organizations have been influential，是现在完成时的主系表结构。like UNESCO 插入举例；in promoting ... 说明发挥影响的领域，for all children 修饰所推动的初等教育。

sentences.text: Many factors influence whether education is successful.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Many factors influence ...。whether education is successful 是宾语从句，表示“教育是否成功”；whether 不表示时间，successful 是从句中 is 后的表语。

sentences.text: Psychological factors include  motivation, intelligence, and personality.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主语 Psychological factors，谓语 include。motivation、intelligence、personality 是三个并列宾语，列举心理因素；它们与下一句的社会因素属于不同类别。

sentences.text: Social factors, like socioeconomic status, ethnicity, and gender, are often linked to discrimination.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subjects.text: Social factors, like socioeconomic status, ethnicity, and gender

sentences.readingHintZh: 先跳过 like 引出的例子，主干是 Social factors are often linked to discrimination。like 后的三个名词举例；linked to 表示有关联，often 表示经常，不能直接读成必然导致歧视。

sentences.text: Further factors include access to educational technology, teacher quality, and parent involvement.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: access to educational technology, teacher quality, and parent involvement

sentences.readingHintZh: include 后列出三个并列因素：access to educational technology、teacher quality、parent involvement。to 只属于 access to 这一搭配，后两项不是 technology 的修饰语。

sentences.text: The main academic field investigating education is called education studies.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subjects.text: The main academic field investigating education

sentences.readingHintZh: 主语中心词是 field，investigating education 是后置的现在分词修饰语。is called 表示“被称为”，education studies 是名称补语；不要把 studies 当成独立的谓语动词。

sentences.text: It examines what education is, what aims and effects it has, and how to improve it.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: what aims and effects it has

sentences.readingHintZh: It 指教育学。examines 后并列三个研究问题：what education is、what aims and effects it has、how to improve it。第二项是完整的间接疑问从句，what 修饰 aims and effects；it has 不是独立的定语从句。

sentences.text: Education studies has many subfields, like philosophy, psychology, sociology, anthropology, and economics of education.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: many subfields, like philosophy, psychology, sociology, anthropology, and economics of education

sentences.readingHintZh: Education studies 在这里是学科名称，整体作单数主语，所以谓语用 has。like 后列出各分支；句末 of education 说明这些分支都与教育有关。

sentences.text: It also discusses comparative education, pedagogy, and the history of education.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: comparative education, pedagogy, and the history of education

sentences.readingHintZh: It 指教育学，also 表示继续补充其研究内容。discusses 后并列 comparative education、pedagogy 和 the history of education；discuss 是及物动词，后面直接接这些对象。

sentences.text: In prehistory, education happened informally through oral communication and imitation.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: In prehistory 是时间状语。主干 education happened，informally 说明形式；through oral communication and imitation 说明途径，and 连接口头交流与模仿。

sentences.text: With the rise of ancient civilizations, writing was invented, and the amount of knowledge grew.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: With the rise ... 交代背景。and 连接 writing was invented 与 the amount of knowledge grew 两个分句，前者被动、后者主动；第二分句的主语中心词是 amount。

sentences.text: This caused a shift from informal to formal education.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: a shift from informal to formal education

sentences.readingHintZh: This 回指文字出现和知识增长等前述变化。主干 This caused a shift；from informal to formal education 描述转变的起点与终点，两个形容词都与 education 搭配。

sentences.text: Initially, formal education was mainly available to elites and religious groups.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: available to elites and religious groups

sentences.readingHintZh: Initially 表示最初阶段。主干 formal education was available to ...，to 后并列 elites 和 religious groups；mainly 表示“主要”，并不等于“仅仅”。

sentences.text: The invention of the printing press in the 15th century made books more widely available.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subjects.text: The invention of the printing press in the 15th century

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 The invention ... made books more widely available。made 是使役动词，books 是宾语，more widely available 是宾语补足语；in the 15th century 交代文中所述发明的时间。

sentences.text: This increased general literacy.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 这是完整的主谓宾句：This 是主语，increased 是过去式谓语，general literacy 是宾语。This 回指上一句书籍更容易获得的变化，literacy 表示识字能力或识字水平。

sentences.text: Beginning in the 18th and 19th centuries, public education became more important.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 public education became more important。Beginning in the 18th and 19th centuries 是表示时间起点的分词短语；more important 是 became 后的表语，说明重要性上升。

sentences.text: This development led to the worldwide process of making primary education available to all, free of charge, and compulsory up to a certain age.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: making primary education available to all, free of charge, and compulsory up to a certain age

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 This development led to the worldwide process。of 后 making ... 说明进程的内容；primary education 是 making 的宾语，available to all、free of charge 和 compulsory ... 三项并列说明其状态，up to a certain age 限定义务教育的年龄范围。

sentences.text: Today, over 90% of all primary-school-age children worldwide attend primary school.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主语是 over 90% of all primary-school-age children，attend 是谓语，primary school 是宾语。worldwide 限定全球范围，Today 指原文写作时点；over 90% 表示超过九成，不是全部。
